name: Ne hodite, detki, v les
source:
Can you imagine a world with perfect people? Relatively ideal. After all, traitors and liars have existed at all times. Is not it? However, people here are deprived of all the vices of modernity. But have these qualities really been completely eradicated from human life? Oh don't worry! They are very close, closer than you can imagine.
So we hope that you will help our ward survive their onslaught!

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-475]official website[/url]]
translation:
你能想象一个人人都很完美的世界吗？这里相对理想。毕竟，叛徒和说谎者从来就存在，对吧？然而这里的人们摆脱了现代社会带来的种种恶习。但这些品质真的能从人类生活中彻底根除吗？别担心！它们离你很近，比你想象的还要近。
所以，希望你能帮我们的受保护者撑过它们的袭击！

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-475]官方网站[/url]]
